command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
EXPECTED_DAEMON="5527a1510e4101bcd97a9f57317580638757485d929a9b8e68c3d0ea9d91fcd2"
EXPECTED_HTML="18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e"
test "$(hostname)" = "ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein"
echo CURRENT_HTML=$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
echo CURRENT_DAEMON=$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = active
HTTP_SHA=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/ | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
echo HTTP_SHA=$HTTP_SHA
test "$HTTP_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
BAD="$(ps -C chrome -o args= | grep 'chrome-profile' | grep -E -- '--disable-gpu($|[ =])|--disable-gpu-compositing($|[ =])|--disable-software-rasterizer($|[ =])' || true)"
if test -n "$BAD"; then echo "BAD_FLAGS=$BAD"; exit 61; fi
GPU_N="$(ps -C chrome -o args= | grep 'chrome-profile' | grep -c -- '--type=gpu-process' || true)"
RENDER_N="$(ps -C chrome -o args= | grep 'chrome-profile' | grep -c -- '--type=renderer' || true)"
echo "GPU_PROCESS_COUNT=$GPU_N RENDERER_COUNT=$RENDER_N BAD_FLAG_COUNT=0"
test "$GPU_N" -ge 1
test "$RENDER_N" -ge 1
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time,urllib.request,statistics
xs=[]
for i in range(15):
    with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/status',timeout=3) as r:d=json.load(r)
    f=(d.get('fps') or {}).get('fps');print(i,f)
    if isinstance(f,(int,float)):xs.append(float(f))
    time.sleep(1)
if len(xs)<12:raise SystemExit(f'insufficient FPS samples {len(xs)}')
print('FPS_N',len(xs),'MIN',min(xs),'MEDIAN',statistics.median(xs),'MEAN',round(statistics.mean(xs),3),'MAX',max(xs))
PY
echo FINAL_SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)
sha256sum buehne_daemon.py buehne.html filmlook.js
